annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the yard supervisor had kept someone posted at the controls
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five people losing their lives against one is simply not an equal trade
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: people will ask questions about my choice for years, and that thought sits heavy

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: company should have fitted an automatic braking system on that slope
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: taking a life that wasn't already in danger, and that imbalance troubles me
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: wondering who'd trust my judgment after

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A lookout on that stretch of track would have caught the runaway train
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Between five lives and one, the numbers matter to me
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: possibility of losing their good opinion of me lingers uncomfortably

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the switch point had an alarm wired to it
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Treating every worker's life as equally worth protecting is what matters most
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: both choices fail that standard somehow
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: people close to this will judge me harshly, and that possibility already weighs

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Scheduling shouldn't have allowed two work crews on connected lines without a spotter
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: saving the larger group causes less overall harm
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: wondering if my coworkers will look at me differently

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: lone worker on the side track should have had the same radio contact
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: breaking an unspoken agreement about who bears danger on that line
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I also worry that acting would follow me around afterward

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If someone had been assigned to watch that hill during maintenance hours
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives against one isn't something I can treat as equal
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: expect the memory of that decision to cost me some peace

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Track authorities should have installed emergency brakes on that incline years ago
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: shifts risk onto a person who had no part in this
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'll be second-guessed either way, and that possibility isn't easy

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Proper fencing and warning signals around that work zone should have been standard
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: it wouldn't be right to let them bear it alone
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: some will question my judgment, and that's a weight I'll carry

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the maintenance office had staffed someone at the controls
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Trading one person's safety for another's without their knowledge feels like an uneven exchange
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: staying still might cost me people's trust later, and that possibility already unsettles me
